content_fields.title: Protect cookie-authenticated routes with SameSite cookies and CSRF tokens (FastAPI)
content_fields.description: If the token is placed in a cookie, set SameSite, Secure and HttpOnly and pair it with a CSRF token; otherwise keep it out of cookies entirely.
content_fields.finding: The access token is returned in the response body with no cookie attributes and no CSRF token issued alongside it.
content_fields.required_fix:
# app/apis/auth/services/get_token_service.py
response.set_cookie(
    "access_token",
    access_token,
    httponly=True,
    secure=True,
    samesite="strict",
    max_age=int(access_token_expires.total_seconds()),
    path="/",
)
response.set_cookie("csrf_token", secrets.token_urlsafe(32), secure=True, samesite="strict")
# every state-changing route then compares the X-CSRF-Token header to the cookie
criteria: No authentication cookie is set without HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite.
Every state-changing route rejects a request whose CSRF header does not match the cookie.
A cross-site form POST against a state-changing route fails.
